justification:
Criterion C1 is met. The progress note REC-0002 records low back pain that spreads to the left leg for 3 weeks, and the progress note REC-0005 records that the pain in the left leg continues at 7 weeks.
Criterion C2 is met. The medication record REC-0003 and the therapy record REC-0004 document conservative therapy: naproxen for 4 weeks and 6 sessions of physical therapy over 3 weeks, with little change.
Criterion C3 is met. The progress note REC-0005 documents new numbness in the left foot and weakness of ankle dorsiflexion.
Criterion C4 is met. The imaging record REC-0001 lists a plain X-ray of the lumbar spine.
